name: QuestionCard
label: Question card
description: An agent's question with answers to pick: one or several, a set asked a step at a time, kept as a record once answered.

props.name: questions
props.description: The questions, asked one at a time when there is more than one.

props.name: values
props.description:
The answers already given. When set, the card renders its answered
state and stops taking input: the options stay where they were, the
picked ones marked and the rest dimmed, so the record of the choice
stays in place. An empty array records a skip.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Fires with every question's answer once the last one is given.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Fires when the person declines to answer. Its presence is what shows the Skip button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The moment to answer has passed: the options stay on screen, dimmed and inert, under a line saying so.

props.name: labels
props.description: Replacement copy for the words the card draws itself.

props.name: items
props.description: The questions and their answers, in the order they were asked.

props.name: missingLabel
props.description: What stands in the answer's place for a question left without one.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`card` draws the summary in its own hairline frame, as a set's record
under the reply that asked it. `plain` drops the frame, for a surface
that brings its own, such as the message bubble that sent the answers.

QuestionCardAnswer.description: What the person answered to one question.

QuestionCardLabels.description: Every word the card draws itself, for a host writing in another voice or language.

QuestionSummaryItem.description: One question in a summary, and what was answered to it.
